verdict.rationale: Evidence describes Mercury as a USD-based account with the ability to send 'no-fee USD payments around the globe,' but there is no mention anywhere in the docs, API, MCP tools, or community feedback of holding or managing balances in multiple currencies (e.g., EUR, GBP) within one account. This suggests Mercury operates as a single-currency (USD) platform for international payments rather than a true multi-currency balance holder.
